decisions.decision: Implemented denotes a present local code path, not a verified proof of the corresponding theorem or full protocol conformance.

Current per-validator Votor: initial notar/skip exclusive. Notar-fallback once per target after40% initial target notar stake, or20% target notar plus60% combined initial notar/skip. Skip-fallback after40% initial stake minus largest notar target. Fallback targets independent;60% union quorums and80% fast finalization. BadWindow interpreted per consensus slot: own skip/fallback blocks own final vote; a final vote prohibits subsequent local fallback. Exact conformance requires review.
Windows are sorted into regional runs: each region's windows stay contiguous, in their seeded draw order, and the schedule moves region to region.

prepare_early streams encrypted prefix slices after previous-window execution; complete_early binds the selected parent in the final slice after ParentReady. ParentReady is certificate-driven; nodes forward authenticated certificate vote proofs and signed handover shreds/attestations. Conformance and sustained performance remain separate verification requirements.
ChaCha20-Poly1305 encrypts each slice under a fresh block key; the commitment binds ciphertext roots and the key hash. Rotor shreds use Reed-Solomon 64/32 and signed Merkle proofs.

Lamports and stake use unsigned decimal strings. priorityFeePerCu is an unsigned decimal string of micro-lamports per CU. Hub ECEF coordinates are integer metres in WGS84. Stake thresholds use integer arithmetic in Votor.

Local defaults: Table1; m4; reserve1,000,000 lamports; track capacity2,000,000 CU; fragment expiry8 slots; inclusion1,000 lamports per accepted copy; base fee5,000 lamports per signature. API local defaults: registry deposit1 SOL, registrationFeeBps500, cooldown1 epoch, inactivity4 epochs; faucet2 SOL,3 grants/key and10/IP per24h. No flat registration fee. Production program identity remains separate configuration.

Final 120-second no-fault acceptance failed: 131 finalized cblocks, slot clocks through1315, all validators stopped at executed899. Pacing p50/p99 50028/993417us; commit spread9599/44485us; finalization479532/1296604us. State hashes matched at563 compared heights,543 with all12 validators; maximum skew223,final0. Real plain and2-of-3 transfers finalized, but skips and stalled execution remain. Keep the frontend fixture gateway.

Version 1 fragment envelope: nonce12, ciphertext length u32 little-endian, Reed-Solomon shard. Key-share envelope: version1, x=index+1, 32 GF(256) bytes. Header signature and AEAD associated data use compact JSON fields id,feePayer,priorityFeePerCu,computeLimit,writableAccounts,targetSlot in that order. Expiry begins at first accepted inclusion; the local default is eight slots.

Recent views are bounded; gateway reads fall back to current-run redb records. The default store directory is target/runs/net. Local restart deliberately begins a new genesis and store rather than resuming votes or execution.

Integration error isolation and complete transaction state behavior require continued checks. The node faucet queues a real signed transfer; API MODE=node preserves its transactionId and signature and returns prior balance for polling.

Each validator owns an OS thread and current-thread runtime. CPU-heavy work is offloaded; commitment authentication is prioritized; traversal and recent views are bounded. A single observer queue renders shared telemetry, storage writes bounded batches, and checkpoints share an immutable executed-ID log. Twenty-one release tests passed; final observer-enabled sustained acceptance remains pending.

Configured one-way delay ranges: FRA/NYC38.964-40.964ms, FRA/TYO54.838-56.838ms, NYC/TYO62.415-64.415ms. With four equally staked validators per hub,60% certificates require at least8/12 and therefore remote evidence. Some certificate-driven handovers exceed a50ms slot; report boundary gaps rather than claiming uninterrupted50ms cadence.
No crate split has been performed because the requested conditional milestone is not yet met. Runtime fixes remain within the existing modules.
